articles.title: Citi slashes 12-month bitcoin, ether targets as ETF flows dry up
articles.snippet: The bank cut its 12-month bitcoin and ether price targets after scrapping its ETF inflow forecasts, citing stalled U.S. crypto legislation and weak investor demand.

articles.title: Anthropic restores AI models Fable, Mythos after the U.S. lifts export controls
articles.snippet: The government cleared Fable 5 and Mythos 5 on June 30, weeks after a cybersecurity finding triggered an export order that froze access for everyone.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital brings off-exchange settlement to Binance
articles.snippet: The integration addresses one of the biggest obstacles keeping institutional capital on the sidelines of crypto markets: exchange counterparty risk.

articles.title: Ethereum backers launch nonprofit to lead institutional adoption efforts
articles.snippet: Backed by Joe Lubin, BitMine and SharpLink, the independent organization will serve as a liaison for financial institutions exploring Ethereum as competition for institutional capital heats up.

articles.title: Anthropic to bring back Fable 5 as US lifts export controls
articles.snippet: Claude Fable 5 will be redeployed with a new set of classifiers designed to identify and block a broader range of cybersecurity-related tasks.
